# DealBoard

> Commission tracking web application for HVAC and trades sales professionals. Built by Ten Eight Studios LLC.

DealBoard helps individual commission-earning sales reps in HVAC and trades industries track deals, auto-calculate commissions, monitor install schedules, and maintain personal earnings records. It is not a company-managed payroll tool — it is rep-owned, mobile-first, and built for people who earn on deals.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dealboard.pro/): Product overview, features, pricing, and waitlist signup
- [Commission Calculator](https://dealboard.pro/commission-calculator.html): Free sales commission calculator supporting MSRP, percentage and fixed discounts, commission rates, and spiffs
- [HVAC Commission Calculator](https://dealboard.pro/hvac-commission-calculator.html): Free HVAC-specific commission calculator for installers and service reps
- [Privacy Policy](https://dealboard.pro/privacy.html): How user data is collected, stored, and protected
- [Terms of Service](https://dealboard.pro/terms.html): Terms governing use of the DealBoard application
